work.title: Euchologium Sinaiticum (selection)
work.edition: Machine translation (gpt-6.1-sol, Patristica, 2026-10-29) of: Euchologium Sinaiticum (Sinai, Sin. slav. 37, Glagolitic, 11th c.): a selection of eight prayers (for a vineyard, the grape harvest, new wine, a house, a herd, at bedtime, and the confessional prayer), not the whole euchologion; TOROT (Tromsø Old Russian and OCS Treebank), Syntacticus release 20230428, Cyrillic transcription.

paragraphs.text: Prayer when someone wishes to plant a vineyard.

You, O Christ, are the true vine, and your Father is the vine grower. You have called your apostles the branches. You brought Israel out of Egypt, drove out the nations, and planted it. So now also, look upon this vineyard. Plant it and establish its roots. Deepen your mercy toward it; surround it with a fence, guarding its entrances and exits. Deliver it from snow, from frost, and from hail driven by a storm. Aloud: For you are a merciful God who loves humankind, and to you.
Prayer over grape clusters for the taking of wine [?].

O God our Savior, who were pleased that your only-begotten Son should be called the vine, our God and Lord Jesus Christ, and who have given us immortal fruit through him: bless the fruit of the vine, through the prayers of the holy Mother of God and all your saints who have pleased you from ages past. Aloud: By the grace and compassion of your only-begotten Son.
Prayer when wine begins to turn sour.

O Lord Jesus Christ our God, who changed water into wine at the wedding in Cana of Galilee and revealed your glory to your disciples: now also visit us from your holy dwelling, and bless this wine. Make it a good blend in every way for those who drink it, so that, without any working of the evil one, we may drink it and glorify you, the giver of every good offering, the Father and the Son and [?].
Prayer for the blessing of a house and dwelling.

O God our Savior, who deigned to enter under the roof of Zacchaeus, bringing salvation to him and his whole household, according to your most pure and immortal utterance, which has truly been proclaimed throughout the world by the evangelists: now also, those who wish to live here and who offer prayers through us, humble and sinful as we are—bless and glorify them, keeping them free from harm and every injury throughout their life in this dwelling, showing them your good gifts, earthly and heavenly. Aloud:

O Master, Lord our God, Almighty, true Lamb who takes away the sins of the whole world, do not disregard the souls praying to you. O lover of humankind, we flee to you and pray to you, who chose your eternal [?] Jacob and multiplied his flocks and delivered him from the hand of Esau and from that of Laban. Now also be pleased to bless this flock and multiply it into thousands and tens of thousands. Deliver us and this flock from the violence of foreigners and from every deadly hour. Guard it through your holy angels. And grant that the one who has acquired it may enjoy it with an unenvious eye and offer praise to you, [?] through the grace and compassion of your only-begotten Son.

Depart, Satan, from these doors and from these four corners. Here you have no place or share. Here is Peter. Here is Paul. Here is the holy Gospel. Here I have bowed down and wish to lie down, in the name of the Father and of the Holy Spirit, now.
Second prayer for the same purpose.

In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, send your Holy Spirit into me. And place in my heart the understanding of your Holy Spirit, who guards my soul and body, and all the members of my body and the whole life of my being, from every evildoer and from every snare of the enemy, and from all sinful temptations. And teach me to offer praise to you, the Father and the Son and the Holy Spirit.
And then enter the church, and let the person wishing to confess fall face down on the ground.

And the priest says this prayer over him: Lord God Almighty, to you I will confess all my sins and this evil conduct of mine: whatever I have spoken, whatever evil I have done, and whatever evil I have thought, whether in word, deed, or thought, everything I remember or do not remember in which I have sinned, or have done unknowingly, under compulsion or without compulsion, asleep or awake, swearing evil oaths and lying, and in unrighteous thoughts, vanity, and folly. Whatever I have done, and every evil in eating, drinking, and improper sleeping, I pray to you, O Lord my God, that you may be pleased to grant me life and mercy, so that I may not be put to shame before your eyes, and so that, while I am still in this world, I may repent of my sins and be able to offer worthy repentance, in keeping with your compassion. Sovereign Lord, O Trinity, Almighty God, be my helper and grant me strength and wisdom, righteous purpose and good will, with true faith, for your service, Lord. You alone came into this world to deliver sinners. Save me. Deliver me, O Lord God, O Son, O Lord. As you wish, as it pleases you, deal with me, your servant, O merciful one. Yes, O God, be pleased to help me, your servant. You alone know, Lord, what my troubles are. To your mercy I entrust my heart and my mind and my love and my life. Put away my sins. Bring my words and my work to completion, Lord, and your mercy show forth in me, your sinful servant. And deliver me, Lord, from all evil, now and always and forever and ever.
